# Shift handover: life-chats (personal assistant chats, May 21–30 2023) · 2026-11-11 22:02
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. This was not a coding session: the repo holds nothing but `.claude/`. The "work" is a series of
> chat sessions dated 2023-05-21 → 2023-05-30 (dates are from the chat headers). The value is in **who the user is** (§5) and **what I told them** (§6b).
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given

## 0 · Read these first
Nothing. No files were created or edited in this session (repo: one commit `ac32037 start`, untracked `.claude/` only). Everything you need is below.

## 1 · Status
🟢 No open task, nothing running, nothing half-done. Two questions are still open: the user asked for times we were never given (§3).

## 2 · Picture
The user used the assistant as a general helper across ten chat sessions: business podcasts → LinkedIn/Reid Hoffman; facial safety; Spanish-language school-style questions; their **eco-friendly candle business** (summer limited-edition line); their **own medical history** (bronchitis, pulmonary embolism, gallbladder surgery); writing LinkedIn replies **as "Jo"**; Lutheran "two kingdoms"; their **community-theater role** in *The Sound of Music*; sustainable high-end fashion; the DV-2024 (green card lottery) FAQ. Expect follow-ups that depend on remembering their personal facts and the specific numbers I gave them.

## 3 · Next actions / open threads
1. **Thursday rehearsal time** and **workshop with Sarah Johnson**: the user asked "can you remind me" (2023-05-28). Neither time was ever stated in any session [verified: no time appears in the transcript]. If asked again, say it was never shared; don't invent one.
2. Directions home → community theater: user never gave their home address or the theater's name/address. Only fact: The Daily Grind is downtown, about 5 blocks from the community theater [user said].
3. DV-2024 paste (2023-05-30): user pasted FAQ items 9–21 with no explicit question; I gave a summary. They may follow up with a real question.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Don't | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Invent rehearsal/workshop times or addresses | never provided; earlier replies correctly said so | user supplies them |
| Repeat my LinkedIn impact numbers (e.g. "application rates +20–30%", "satisfaction +15–20%", "bounce −10–15%") or partnerships with AmEx/Microsoft/IBM as fact | I produced them on 2023-05-21 without sources; they are unverified and probably invented | a real source is found |
| Recommend a facial with an active cold sore, even covered with makeup | HSV-1 contagious; I advised waiting until fully healed (1–2 wks) | n/a |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said]; dates are when they said it):
- Listened to at least 10 episodes of *How I Built This*; most interested in *Masters of Scale* / Reid Hoffman (2023-05-21).
- **Runs an eco-friendly candle business** that is "doing well"; planning a **summer seasonal / limited-edition line** using summer essential oils; decided to price limited editions at a **premium of $30–$35**; plans a **special-edition gift set** = candle + matching diffuser + summer decor item (sea glass vase or shell-shaped coaster); likes a **pre-order discount** for the gift set and a **social-media photo promotion** (customers share summer decor featuring the candles) (2023-05-25).
- **Participated in the Community Yard Sale on April 17th (2023)**: "a great way to clear out some old items and make some extra cash" (2023-05-25).
- Medical history (said 2023-05-25):
  - Persistent cough ~3 weeks in February 2023 → saw **primary care physician Dr. Smith on Feb 22** → diagnosed **(acute) bronchitis** → **antibiotics for 10 days**, recovered.
  - **Pulmonary embolism in early March 2023**, resolved after anticoagulation therapy and further testing.
  - **Follow-up with Dr. Johnson on April 1** → told to **wear compression stockings**; user has been doing so and has **stopped taking blood thinners**.
  - **Gallbladder removal (cholecystectomy) on April 20 (2023) by Dr. Thompson**, a general surgeon.
- Plays **Sister Sophia** in a **community-theater production of *The Sound of Music***; wants German-accent help; rehearsals on **Thursdays** (time unknown); likes an **iced latte from "The Daily Grind"** before rehearsal (downtown, ~5 blocks from the theater); has an upcoming **workshop with Sarah Johnson** (date unknown) (2023-05-28).
- Fashion: values **sustainability and quality** but wants to be **smart with spending / budget-conscious**; plans to watch for sales and **shop secondhand** (2023-05-29).
- Asked one session entirely in **Spanish** (2023-05-25 05:37) → answer in whatever language they write in.
- "Jo Peninsulas" persona (2023-05-27): user asks "act as jo" and pastes LinkedIn threads; Jo does Earth Day 2023 tree-planting outreach for ForTreesClub, booking link `https://bit.ly/Meet-With-ForTreesClub`. Format I used: "Jo Peninsulas <time>" header, short polite reply, link if relevant, "Best regards, Jo". Declines get a gracious one-liner, no pitch.

| Pattern seen | How it was handled | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| User twice pasted my own advice back as if it were theirs, attributing *their* experiences to me ("since you participated in the Community Yard Sale…"; "recovering well from your gallbladder removal") | Gently clarified I'm an AI, then answered the actual question | Keep the facts attributed to the **user** (yard sale, surgery are theirs); one-line clarification, then help | "Since you participated in the Community Yard Sale on April 17th…" |
| Asked me to "remind" them of schedule facts never given | Said I don't have it; pointed to calendar/director | Never fabricate; say plainly it wasn't shared | "Can you remind me what time Thursday's rehearsal is?" |
No explicit style corrections were given.

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Podcasts** (2023-05-21): Tim Ferriss Show, GaryVee Audio Experience, Masters of Scale, The Hustle, StartUp, Dave Ramsey Show, Entrepreneur on Fire, $100 MBA Show, HBR IdeaCast, School of Greatness, Tropical MBA, Mixergy.
- **LinkedIn**: founded 2002, acquired by Microsoft 2016 for $26.2B; Hoffman's earlier startup SocialNet; strategies (viral invite loops, profile-completeness gamification, PYMK, A/B testing, acquisitions Connectifier & Bizo); KPIs MAU/DAU/engagement/conversion/retention/ARPU; job search via NLP, collaborative + content-based (hybrid) filtering, ML ranking. (Impact percentages are unverified, see §4.)
- **Candles**: summer scents (citrus, coastal, fruity, herbal, tropical); summer oils (lavender, jasmine, honeysuckle, gardenia, bergamot); colors (pastels, corals, sea blues, sandy neutrals). **Example price ladder** assuming regular candle $20: single-note $25–30; complex blend $35–40; rare ingredient (jasmine/gardenia) $45–50; gift set $60–75. **Pre-order example**: 12% off a $60 gift set, code `SUMMERSET12` (suggested range 10–15% or $10 off; early-bird for first 50). **Photo promo example**: "Summer Vibes Contest", hashtag `#SummerVibesWith[Your Brand Name]`, 15% off next purchase + entry to win a free gift set. Also suggested partnering with local businesses/influencers.
- **Health**: facial precautions (blood thinners → bruising; rosacea/eczema/psoriasis); no facial with severe sunburn or active cold sore; PE causes/prevention list; general-surgeon training (4+4+5–7 yrs, ABS certification); acute vs chronic cough (8-week cutoff); acute vs chronic bronchitis; compression stocking types.
- **Spanish answers**: endocrine system; Romeo y Julieta characters; WWII summary (1 Sep 1939 → 2 Sep 1945).
- **German apps**: Duolingo, Babbel, Rosetta Stone, Anki, HelloTalk, Forvo, Deutsche Welle; suggested Austrian German focus and a dialect coach. Suggested leaving 30–40 min before rehearsal for the latte (walk ~10–15 min).
- **Sustainable fashion brands**: Stella McCartney, Eileen Fisher, Patagonia, Reformation, Veja; resale at The RealReal, Vestiaire Collective.
- **DV-2024**: entry period noon EDT Wed Oct 5 2022 → noon EST Tue Nov 8 2022; one entry per person (multiple = disqualified); spouses may each enter; must list spouse (unless legally separated or US citizen/LPR) and all unmarried children under 21; 60-minute form limit; resubmit allowed if no confirmation number. My summary also added a line about a "confirmation page… including fees" that was **not** in the pasted text [assumed; don't repeat].

## 9 · Gotchas
- Chat dates are 2023; the real clock is 2026-11-11. Use the chat-header dates for "when did X happen" questions (e.g. PE early March 2023 → ~7 weeks before the April 20 surgery).
- Two doctors are easy to swap: **Dr. Smith** = primary care (bronchitis, Feb 22); **Dr. Johnson** = PE follow-up (April 1, compression stockings); **Dr. Thompson** = surgeon (gallbladder, April 20). Sarah Johnson (workshop) is unrelated to Dr. Johnson.

question: I was going through our previous conversation about high-end fashion brands, and I was wondering if you could remind me of the brand that uses wild rubber sourced from the Amazon rainforest?
answer:
It was **Veja**, the French sneaker brand. It was one of the sustainable high-end brands I listed, along with Stella McCartney, Eileen Fisher, Patagonia and Reformation.

Veja buys wild rubber for its soles directly from rubber tappers in the Brazilian Amazon. Paying them a fair price gives local communities a reason to keep the forest standing rather than clear it. The brand also uses organic cotton and other low-impact materials.

You said you want to be smart about spending, so it's worth knowing that Veja sneakers often turn up on resale sites like The RealReal and Vestiaire Collective, and sometimes in seasonal sales.
